title: Farewell to Jackie, the Famous Bald Eagle of Big Bear
summary:
If you've ever watched a live webcam of eagles, you might know Jackie. She was a famous bald eagle who lived in Big Bear Valley, California. Sadly, Jackie died on August 10, 2026. She was about 14 years old.

Jackie's troubles started in mid-July when she got into a fight with two young eagles. She was found on the ground, unable to fly. A rescue team took her to the Ojai Raptor Center. But the fight wasn't the only problem. Jackie was very anemic (meaning she didn't have enough red blood cells) and had other serious health issues. Vets gave her oxygen, fluids, and a blood transfusion, but she didn't get better.

Jackie became famous because of a livestream camera set up by Friends of Big Bear Valley. People all over the world watched her and her mate, Shadow, raise their chicks. They were one of the most famous eagle pairs ever!

Jackie's story began in 2012 when she hatched from a nest in Big Bear Valley. She was the first bald eagle chick known to have hatched there. After she left the nest, she came back years later and paired with a male named Mr. B. Then a new eagle named Shadow showed up, and Mr. B left. Jackie and Shadow became partners.

Now, Shadow is back at the nest with a younger eagle named Kaydee. It's too soon to tell if they'll become mates. But Jackie's story will live on through the nest she called home.

Even though Jackie is gone, her life reminds us how special nature can be. And if you want to see what happens next, you can keep watching the nest!
why_it_matters: Jackie's story helps us care about wild animals and shows how nature, and the people who protect it, can bring people together.

background_read: Bald eagles are large birds with white heads and are a symbol of the United States.
Big Bear Valley (a mountain area in Southern California) is where Jackie lived, and Friends of Big Bear Valley (a local group that cares about eagles) set up the nest camera.
The Ojai Raptor Center (a rescue place for hurt birds like eagles) took care of Jackie after she was found hurt.
Article_Structure: WHO: Jackie, a famous bald eagle in Big Bear Valley, California, and her mate Shadow.
WHAT: Jackie got hurt in a fight, was rescued by vets, but died because she had serious health problems.
WHERE: In Big Bear Valley, California, and at the Ojai Raptor Center.
WHY: She became famous because a livestream camera let people around the world watch her raise chicks.

perspectives.perspective: People who watched the nest camera
perspectives.description: They feel sad to lose Jackie, but are grateful for the years of watching her raise chicks and are curious about what will happen in the nest next.

perspectives.perspective: The rescue team at Ojai Raptor Center
perspectives.description: They did everything they could to help Jackie, giving her oxygen and a blood transfusion, but some wild animals are too sick to save.
Her story reminds us why protecting nature and wild spaces matters, and why webcams can help people feel connected to animals.
